name: Cross-Border Payment Compliance Pipeline
description: End-to-end automation for international B2B wire transfers — real-time FX rate locking, SWIFT beneficiary validation, multi-jurisdiction sanctions screening, and automated GL posting with regulatory audit trail.
output: Transfer Executed — Regulatory Audit Trail Filed

agents.name: FX Rate Lock Agent
agents.role: Fetches real-time FX rates from treasury feed, locks the exchange rate for the transfer window, and records the rate agreement in the ERP to prevent slippage exposure

agents.name: SWIFT Beneficiary Validator
agents.role: Validates IBAN, BIC/SWIFT codes and beneficiary bank details against the SWIFT network, performs name-matching against known counterparty records, and flags mismatches for review

agents.name: Multi-Jurisdiction AML Screener
agents.role: Runs the transaction and all involved parties through OFAC, EU consolidated list, UN sanctions, and FinCEN watchlists simultaneously — auto-holds any transaction with a match score above threshold

agents.name: Regulatory GL Posting Agent
agents.role: Posts the confirmed wire transfer to the general ledger with full regulatory metadata, generates the BSA/AML transaction record, and archives the complete audit package to the document vault
